body:
Part of #1446 (first slice: the motion-crate generator, `camcraft_motion::machining2d::rest_plan` / `rest_pocket`, on branch `issue/1446-rest-2d`).

Asked for by the maintainer (2026-11-13, quoted on #1446): "We wanna cover some of the toolpaths and things like that at first." and "Lets create issues on your suggestions, they made sense."

What is wanted: the 2D Pocket operation can use the rest generator.

- A "Rest machining" group on the 2D Pocket operation: on/off (default off), previous tool diameter, previous tool corner radius, stock the previous operation left on the walls, rest allowance. Off posts exactly what the operation posts today.
- The values are operation parameters: edited through the existing undoable parameter command (undo/redo restore them), saved in and read from the project file (an older file reads as off), validated at command creation with the generator's own refusals (previous tool not larger than this tool; Zigzag and Adaptive with rest on).
- Generation calls `rest_pocket` when the group is on; its notes (the "trusts the entered previous tool" note) reach the operation's notes.
- MCP: the same parameters on the pocket operation DTO, with the camcraft-mcp skill row.
- A golden CL through the app for the issue's fixture (a pocket with 3 mm corners, roughed by a 12 mm tool, rest pass with a 4 mm tool) and a stock-simulation reading: no pass over cleared floor, no rapid or plunge into uncut stock after the roughing operation has been simulated.
- UI text in plain English; before/after screenshots in the PR.

Safety: this changes posted G-code for the operations that turn it on, so the review runs at the effort:high tier. No code or text from any other CAM product (Clean-Room Protocol).

Done means: a Pocket operation with rest machining on generates the corner-only passes for the fixture above (golden CL), undo/redo restore the group's values, a saved project reopens with them, the MCP tool sets them, a previous tool that is not larger is refused by name at the edit, and the default (off) output of every existing pocket golden is unchanged.
